zh-CN.name: 有机亲自然
zh-CN.description: 工作用视觉标签：用自然意象、非机械轮廓和温和材质表达亲自然感。它不是健康效果保证，也不要求给每个组件添加叶子、波浪或随机圆角。
use_when: 品牌主题与自然、生活或温和触感相关。
装饰能辅助情绪而不遮挡任务信息。
avoid_when: 不规则形状不应损害对齐与可点击范围。
不要声称绿色与自然素材自动改善用户健康。
zh-CN.prompt_template:
选用自然相关的色彩与适量素材，在装饰区域采用有机轮廓；功能组件仍保持稳定栅格、明确边界与文字对比；纹理轻量化，避免影响正文阅读和页面性能。
专属演示：自然叶片、曲线分区与生长进度，支持本地照料状态切换。 参数：圆角 {corner_px}px；内容间距 {gap_px}px；强调色 {accent}。

en.name: Organic Biophilic
en.description: A working visual label for nature-related imagery, less mechanical contours and gentle material cues. It does not guarantee health benefits or require leaves, waves and random rounded shapes on every component.
use_when: The brand relates to nature, daily life or a gentle tactile tone.
Decoration supports mood without obscuring task information.
avoid_when: Irregular shapes must not undermine alignment or usable targets.
Do not claim that green colors or natural motifs automatically improve health.
en.prompt_template:
Use nature-related colors and selective imagery, with organic contours in decorative areas. Keep functional components on a stable grid with clear boundaries and readable contrast. Use lightweight textures that do not impair reading or page performance.
Dedicated demonstration: Organic leaves, curved sections and a growth meter with a local care-state toggle. Parameters: corner radius {corner_px}px; content gap {gap_px}px; accent color {accent}.
